# honjoh.dev

> Personal site and project hub by Nobuhiro Honjoh (本城靖大).

## Main Project: Yamato Layout (大和配列)

> A keyboard layout optimized for Japanese input.
> URL: https://honjoh.dev/yamato
> Full reference: https://honjoh.dev/yamato/about
> Full reference (English): https://honjoh.dev/yamato/about/en
> Detailed info: https://honjoh.dev/llms-full.txt

Yamato Layout is a keyboard layout designed for efficient Japanese romaji input by separating consonants (left hand) and vowels (right hand).

### Key Facts
- Consonants on the left, vowels on the right — matches Japanese "consonant → vowel" rhythm
- Consonants follow Japanese syllabary order (50-on): Ka-Sa-Ta-Na-Ha on home row
- Home row usage: ~76% (vs QWERTY ~34%)
- Finger movement reduction: ~40% less than QWERTY
- Windows-only. Works with standard QWERTY keyboards via AutoHotkey
- Also optimized for English, Chinese (Pinyin), and Korean input

### Key Layout
```
Top:    M  Y  R  W  P  |  X  L  Q  C  '  [  ]
Home:   K  S  T  N* H  |  F  A* O  I  E  /
Bottom: Z  D  B  G  J  |  V  U  -  ,  .
(* = home position keys)
```
